# Cashfree Payments Announces 0% Payment Gateway Fees for New Businesses Till March 2027

* Published By: Vishal
* July 22, 2026 / 06:37 PM IST

* [](https://www.facebook.com/sharer.php?u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.telugutimes.net%2Fen%2Fbnews%2Fcashfree-payments-announces-0-payment-gateway-fees-for-new-businesses-till-march-2027-353990.html "facebook")
* [](https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.telugutimes.net%2Fen%2Fbnews%2Fcashfree-payments-announces-0-payment-gateway-fees-for-new-businesses-till-march-2027-353990.html&text=Cashfree+Payments+Announces+0%25+Payment+Gateway+Fees+for+New+Businesses+Till+March+2027 "twitter")
* [](whatsapp://send?text=Cashfree+Payments+Announces+0%25+Payment+Gateway+Fees+for+New+Businesses+Till+March+2027 https%3A%2F%2Fwww.telugutimes.net%2Fen%2Fbnews%2Fcashfree-payments-announces-0-payment-gateway-fees-for-new-businesses-till-march-2027-353990.html (Sent from https://www.telugutimes.net/) "whatsapp")

Cashfree Payments has announced a major initiative waiving payment gateway fees for all new businesses signing up on its platform, offering 0% fees on the first ₹20 lakh of Gross Merchandise Value (GMV) until March 31, 2027. Designed specifically for early-stage and growing sellers operating on their own online channels, the offer aims to provide a robust financial cushion ahead of the critical festive season.

**Strategic Timing and Margin Relief:** 
 Highlighting the timing of the initiative, Cashfree Co-founder and CEO Akash Sinha noted that average SMBs and D2C brands generate roughly 40% of their annual sales during the festive months. Because seasonal discounts and marketing overheads often compress profit margins, removing payment gateway fees during this peak window provides businesses with vital cash flow to reinvest into inventory, advertising, and logistics. Furthermore, data indicates that 90% of new sellers signing up ahead of the season record a GMV under ₹20 lakh, meaning the offer effectively covers their entire festive run.

**Accelerated Onboarding and Dedicated Support:** 
 In addition to the financial fee waiver, the program delivers several key operational advantages for newly onboarded merchants:

**Rapid Go-Live:** Sellers can complete onboarding and go live within minutes of signing up, bypassing the traditional multi-day industry norm.

**Next-Day Settlements:** Merchants benefit from a next-day settlement cycle instead of the standard two-day window, significantly boosting liquidity for rapid restocking and ad spend during peak sales.

Dedicated Account Management: Every participating merchant is assigned a dedicated account manager from the moment of signup to ensure continuous operational support throughout the busy festive window.

# Cashfree Payments launches ‘One of Your Kind’ campaign highlighting unique business journeys

by Lyene Marie Darang

## March 11, 2026

**India** – Cashfree Payments has unveiled its latest brand campaign, **‘**One of Your Kind’, which focuses on the distinctive journeys of the businesses the platform supports.

The campaign, conceptualised by Talented and produced by At All Odds, shifts the traditional B2B fintech narrative. Instead of framing businesses as uniform “friction points” to be solved, the campaign highlights how category disruptors across E-commerce, Travel, F&B, and SaaS face fundamentally different challenges, and how payments infrastructure can support their unique operations.

**Aditi Olemann, vice president of marketing and communications at Cashfree Payments**, said, “The One of Your Kind campaign is our way of saying: we see you, not as a transaction category, but as a company that built something no else built, in a way no one else would have. And these businesses deserve payments that are built to be One of Your Kind.”

The campaign film also features Cashfree Payments’ long-standing partners, including BigBasket, Third Wave Coffee, and Redbus. The narrative is presented in a documentary style, portraying the lived-in growth journeys of these businesses rather than polished corporate imagery, while positioning Cashfree Payments’ infrastructure as the supporting backbone.

**Akshat Chaturvedi, Karthik Nambiar, and Nikhil Unni from Talented** said, “In a category where capabilities converge, we recognised an opportunity to differentiate through perspective. Payment gateways compete on features, but businesses are rarely spoken to in ways that reflect how differently they operate.”

**Sanjana Krishnan and Rohan Shetty, directors of the campaign,** also added, “This was one of those rare film shoots where we didn’t have sets to build. We moved like flies on the wall, letting the rhythm of the environment dictate the frame. Every detail had to feel intentional, even when the moment itself was unscripted.”

The campaign reflects Cashfree Payments’ approach to building payments infrastructure around the specific pressures of different industries.  According to the company, ‘One of Your Kind’ demonstrates a philosophy of adapting infrastructure to the needs of the business, rather than offering a one-size-fits-all solution.

# Cashfree Payments Launches ‘Relay’, AI Super Agents to Automate End-to-End Payment Operations for SMBs

2 min

Follow Facebook LinkedIn Instagram

**By BFSI Network** · 26 August 2026 · News

Cashfree Payments has launched **Relay**, an AI-powered “Super Agents” platform designed to automate end-to-end payment operations for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) and startups. The solution, which has been in beta with merchants since May, is now available to all Cashfree merchants.

Relay is designed to take over repetitive payment-related tasks such as **failed payment retries, abandoned cart recovery, cash-on-delivery confirmation, subscription management and dispute filing**. Unlike conventional automation tools that simply flag tasks for merchants, Relay executes the required actions directly using merchant transaction data.

Advertisement[](https://nbfc100.eletsonline.com/)

According to Cashfree Payments, **seven out of 10 Indian SMBs manage payment operations entirely manually**, while others often rely on fragmented tools that address only individual workflows. The company estimates that an average SMB spends nearly **60 hours a week** on payment operations. Relay aims to reduce this workload to **less than 45 minutes**, allowing businesses to focus more on growth and customer engagement.

Merchants can configure Relay by describing the desired outcome in **plain language or through voice**, without requiring complex AI configurations. The platform can either create a customised agent or deploy a pre-trained, turnkey agent within minutes.

Advertisement[](https://nbfc100.eletsonline.com/)

Relay agents are trained on Cashfree’s payments data, enabling them to understand payment workflows and execute tasks with greater efficiency. The platform operates entirely on **Cashfree’s infrastructure**, with merchant transaction data not shared with external AI providers.

Advertisement[](https://www.worldaisummit.com/)

The system also incorporates merchant approvals at critical stages, including **before money is moved and before a customer is contacted**, while keeping all actions visible to merchants.

Advertisement[](https://events.eletsonline.com/bfsi-ai-summit/)

**Reeju Datta, Co-founder, Cashfree Payments**, said Relay is intended to act as an intelligent team member for lean SMB teams by taking over time-consuming payment workflows and giving founders more time to focus on growth.

**Also Read: Nikhil Kamath Invests ₹200 Crore in CtrlS Datacenters to Back India’s AI Infrastructure Boom**

Cashfree’s **Chief Technology Officer Ramkumar Venkatesan** said AI-driven business process automation can deliver significant ROI for SMBs by replacing manual work and fragmented point solutions with intelligent, end-to-end automation.

Relay is **free for all Cashfree merchants at launch**, with the company planning to introduce outcome-based pricing as adoption increases.

Cashfree Payments is a cloud-based payment processing and banking solution, designed to help businesses across retail, finance, education and various other sectors collect payments, send vendor or wage payouts and reimburse expenses.

## Compare Cashfree Payments to Competitors

Razorpay

Razorpay operates as a payment solution provider in the fintech sector, offering services for online payment processing and financial management. The company provides products including payment gateways, payment links, custom payment pages, and in-store payment solutions for businesses. Razorpay also offers services such as subscription billing, smart collect for businesses, and cross-border payments, serving startups, enterprises, and various sectors such as education, Software as a Service (BFSI), and Software as a Service (SaaS).It was founded in 2014 and is based in Bengaluru, India.

Stashfin

Stashfin is a financial services platform that provides digital lending, investment, and insurance. The company offers products including personal loans, corporate bonds for investment, and various insurance plans, through a digital process that may include documentation and approvals. Stashfin's services are aimed at individuals looking to manage credit, invest in bonds, and obtain insurance. It was founded in 2016 and is based in Gurgaon, India.

Checkout.com

Checkout.com provides payment processing and financial solutions for online businesses. Its main services include processing payments, sending payouts, and managing card programs through a cloud-based solution. It supports a range of payment methods, includes fraud detection, compliance, and risk management, and provides tools for payment management. Checkout.com was formerly known as Opus Payments. It was founded in 2009 and is based in London, United Kingdom.

BillDesk

BillDesk focuses on digital payments and digital commerce within the financial technology industry. The company offers technology and integrated solutions that make digital payments easy and accessible for merchants, financial institutions, and governments. Its main services include a technology platform and unified APIs that make payments efficient. BillDesk was founded in 2000 and is based in Mumbai, India.

PhonePe

PhonePe offers a range of financial services across various sectors. The company provides a platform for UPI payments, online payment gateway services, and financial products, including insurance and investment options. PhonePe caters to both businesses and consumers, offering solutions like offline payment services, merchant lending, and an app marketplace, as well as personal loans and digital gold investments. PhonePe was formerly known as FX Mart. It was founded in 2015 and is based in Bangalore, India.

PayUbiz

PayUbiz is an online payment gateway service provider within the financial technology sector. The company offers a platform for merchants to accept payment methods including credit cards, debit cards, and netbanking. PayUbiz serves the ecommerce industry by offering payment services to online businesses. It is based in Gurugram, India.

# Innovation Through Data in Fintech

Tap into the transformative power of data. Tune in as our CDO Keren Ben Zvi shares her perspective on how to use data as a powerful tool.

Get a glimpse into the heart of fintech innovation with PayU GPO latest episode of Payments30. In this installment, we introduce the transformative power of data within our operations. Join us as we explore how leveraging data has become instrumental in enhancing customer experiences, revolutionizing risk management, and ensuring regulatory compliance.

#### Leveraging Data to Improve Customer Experience:

At PayU, we recognize that data is not just information; it’s a powerful tool that transforms the way we serve our customers. Fintech innovation thrives on the comprehensive utilization and insightful analysis of data, and at the heart of our approach is a commitment to making data our game-changer. By harnessing the potential of data, we have redefined the customer experience. Every interaction is an opportunity to enhance satisfaction, and we leverage data to drive improvements that are grounded in facts and thorough analysis. 

 

#### Putting Data at the Forefront for Risk Management:

In the ever-evolving landscape of fintech, precision and agility are imperative in the realm of risk management. Here, data is not just a tool; it is the foundation upon which we construct sophisticated risk models. Operating in real-time, these models empower us not only to identify potential risks but to predict and prevent them. This foresight, facilitated by our robust data strategy, has translated into substantial savings for the businesses we serve. 

 

The utilization of data in risk management goes beyond traditional practices. It’s about more than just identifying potential risks; it’s about foreseeing them and implementing effective strategies to mitigate them. Our commitment to leveraging data for risk management doesn’t just safeguard financial transactions; it cultivates an environment where businesses can thrive confidently, knowing that they have a partner dedicated to staying ahead of the curve in identifying and mitigating risks. 

#### Efficiency through Automated Regulatory Reporting:

PayU has integrated automated regulatory reporting into our processes, ensuring efficiency and accuracy in meeting compliance requirements. The implementation of automated reporting not only saves time but also minimizes the risk of errors, allowing us to stay aligned with regulatory standards seamlessly.

# Your utlimate guide to online payment methods

* Home > Online Payment Methods

## Which online payment methods are the best for expansion?

Payment methods have evolved significantly from the traditional ‘cash or card?’ society. To meet the growing e-commerce demand, merchants must keep up with the evolving needs of customers in diverse markets. Perhaps nowhere is this challenge more prominent – and yet more overlooked – than in the question of which online payment methods merchants should offer their customers. In order to deliver a localized checkout experience, many merchants are focused on the question of how to offer as many popular online payment methods as possible – with a need to integrate these as easily and seamlessly as possible within existing payment stacks.

How can merchants determine which payment methods to offer – and what must merchants do to ensure that they can make the most popular payment methods available to customers regardless of geography? Read on for an overview as well as an introduction to PayU’s online payment methods offering.

* 

 ### Card Payments

 One of the most popular online payment methods worldwide. We accept all Visa and Mastercard cards issued in any currency and in any country in the world.

 Learn more
* 

 ### E-Wallets

 E-wallets (also known as digital wallets or mobile wallets) encompass different forms of software that provides the equivalent of a wallet for electronic commerce, often storing several payment methods in one place

 Learn more
* 

 ### Buy Now Pay Later (BNPL)

 BNPL allow the merchant to be paid upfront before the customer pays for the transaction. The provider fronts the transaction amount and takes on any risk of frauds. Seller receives the funds immediately, risk-free.

 Learn more
* 

 ### Online Bank Transfers

 Direct online bank transfers are a popular method of payment for e-commerce transactions. Customer is redirected to their internet banking and confirms the payment. Always the right account, always the right amount.

 Learn more
* 

 ### Local Schemes

 Alternative payment methods are categorized as non-traditional methods, typically popular within a specific region. Either extensions of traditional payment methods, or as a standalone solution separated from traditional frameworks.

 Learn more

## The e-commerce boom’s impact on payments

E-commerce was the long-term trend in retail even before the pandemic, a trend which has only accelerated since everything changed in the Spring of 2020. Shopping online has become the norm for more global customers than ever before – a new reality which has given way to new, alternative, payment methods beyond the traditional credit and debit card providers. Although alternative payment methods are responsible for a growing number of transactions in Western Europe, they are particularly prevalent in emerging markets.

Alternative payment methods typically offer customers better flexibility in payments (such as Buy-Now-Pay-Later (BNPL), payment with e-wallets, cash options, and more). At the same time, these online payment methods function can also as a means of digital and financial inclusion for unbanked populations who do not have access to traditional credit cards or bank accounts.

# Online payment processing

* Home > Online Payment Processing

## Sell in any market – with one payment solution

Powering more than 10 million daily transactions, PayU’s suite of global payment solutions are trusted each day by more than 450,000 merchants and millions of customers around the world.

As an advanced provider of online payments for companies ranging from small and medium enterprises to some of the biggest names in global e-commerce, PayU enables merchants of any size, in any market, to benefit from industry-leading tools to securely process online payments, maximize conversions and payment approvals, and boost online revenue.

PayU’s PCI-certified online payment gateway combines advanced technology and analytics with simple and straightforward tools to ensure the most important aspects of security and regulatory compliance when it comes to accepting online payments.

Offering one of the industry’s largest selections of local and global online payment methods, our platform leverages the latest tools in AI and global fintech to help merchants offer a smooth checkout experience to any customer around the world – all through a single global API.

## The need for a global payment solution

Although the act of sending and receiving money online continues to get easier for consumers, the process of ensuring safe, reliable, secure payments at the back end has become increasingly complex for online merchants. While the growth of e-commerce continues to create more global business opportunities than ever before, new payment providers, industry standards, and security and regulatory requirements are constantly entering the arena. For merchants selling in multiple markets with overlapping payment rules and regulations, the situation can be especially difficult.

With every international transaction interacting with a multitude of different potential acquiring banks, payment processors, and payment method providers, many of which are unique to specific markets, the importance of a global solution to integrate these diverse payment layers has never been more clear.

PayU offers merchants the simplicity and convenience of a single dashboard to manage global payments – while at the same time connecting the different layers of complex global payment stacks together to ensure that every potential payment is processed as efficiently and successfully as possible, no matter where it takes place.

## Payment security

### Tokenization

Tokenization protects both merchant and consumer by encrypting a user’s personal payment data during a transaction. By employing tokenization, PayU enables merchants to offer a more secure checkout experience, while reducing PCI scope.

Learn more

### PCI DSS Compliance

PCI DSS applies to anyone handling personal credit card data – including online merchants. As a PCI Level 1-certified online payment processor, PayU helps merchants reduce their PCI scope by taking on the responsibility for safeguarding customer information.

Learn more

### 3D Secure

3D Secure is a protocol for payment security geared toward industry best practices as well as European Union requirements for customer authentication. PayU helps merchants implement the latest version of 3DS through a variety of functionalities including the Smart Routing Engine and more.

Learn more

# Uthrive & Employee Wellbeing

As we deeply care about our physical, mental and emotional health we are constantly widening our safety net of support programs, community-building, and numerous other initiatives.

## Building a healthy & thriving community at PayU

At PayU we see Employee Wellbeing as a holistic approach: we spend a lot of energy cultivating, designing, building, and evaluating our initiatives and are very proud of them.

As we care deeply about the wellbeing of our employees, including those who work remotely or outside traditional office hours, we take a closer look into adressing their needs the best way possible. To achieve this, we established Uthrive. A holistic wellbeing programm with various initiatives driven by our Uthrive team. Consisting of ten dedicated members from across our organization, the Uthrive team provides PayUneers with consistent support around physical and mental wellbeing. Learn more about Uthrive below.

## Uthrive – our wellbeing initiative

Uthrive is an initiative that aims to build a culture of physical, mental and emotional well-being for every PayUneer.

* 

 ### The Wellbeing Survey

 Deep listening is at the core of our values. To build solid initiatives with campaigns that really make a difference, we listen before we act. The Wellness Survey provides us with insights on the needs of our PayUneers.

 

 

 ### Initiatives improving work-life balance

 For managers and team members alike, we have curated 4 courses from Harvard with information on boosting employee well-being, empowering employees, good (remote) manager practices and communicating with empathy. Further, the Uthrive team shares practical tips for well-being on a bi-weekly basis.
* 

 ### Initiatives supporting PayUneers through the pandemic

 To stay physically & mentally fit while working from home, we hold our Wellness Wednesday group sessions on zoom with PayUneers from across the world. Additionally we consistently organize motivational sessions and webinars on topics such as “The Power of Presence” or “Finding Peace”.

 

 

 ### Initiatives supporting social connections

 Know Your Peers is our casual networking event to where PayUneers from across the world meet online to share whats on their minds. Humans of PayU is our storytelling initiave empowering PayUneers to shre their authentic selves

## The Uthrive Team

A team of ten dedicated members from all across our business is the driving force behind all Uthrive initiative campaigns.

What are the challenges of cross-border sales and how do you achieve success? Cross-border e-commerce is one of the dominant trends in online sales and a direction of growth for many businesses operating in the e-commerce sector. Cross-border sales open the door for companies to a powerful international – and sometimes even global – market made up of e-consumers with varied preferences, who look for innovative products and competitive prices. Entering the cross-border sales path can become a significant source of additional revenue for online shops that are already well-established and have an extensive customer base in the local market. How to prepare for the expansion? What should you know about cross-border e-commerce? What are the challenges of cross-border sales? Martes Sport, an online shop with several years of experience in online sales, which is currently present in seven markets: Poland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia, Romania, Austria, Hungary and Germany, offers a few tips. ‘The success of Martes Sport is closely associated with a recognizable brand that is already present in around 370 locations in Poland, the Czech Republic and Romania. The long-standing leading position of the Martes Sport chain of shops in Poland and the recognition of our own brands are two factors underlying the success of sklepmartes.pl.’. – Piotr Szałaśny, Martes Sport eCommerce Manager. ‘Cross-border sales create an opportunity for further growth for online shops of all sizes. The story of Martes Sport shows that nothing is impossible, and a cohesive team, dedication, and focus on the customer’s needs bring results.’. – Joanna Pieńkowska-Olczak, CEO PayU GPO in the CEE region. # Referral Program

The Referral Program is designed for businesses seeking to collaborate with PayU. This program is particularly relevant for various types of e-commerce platforms and web developers who are involved in integrating payment services for their clients.

If you're interested in the program and would like to gain insights into compensation, business terms, and the process of becoming a participant, feel free to get in touch with us at partners-pl@payu.com.

Here, you'll discover instructions on registering a merchant in a way that allows us to identify that the referral came from you and subsequently provide compensation.

## Registration via Link​

Registration link is the easiest way to register the referred merchants in the PayU system. Please be aware that at present, only merchants interested in conducting business in Poland can be registered through the provided link.

You have the option to share the link with potential merchants either through email or by embedding it on your website. This link can be utilized multiple times, and anyone who clicks on it will be directed to the PayU registration procedure. Any business that successfully completes the registration process will be marked as having been referred by you.

`https://secure.payu.com/boarding/#/form?lang=pl&nsf=false&partnerId=someid`

| lang | No | If not present, the default value will be used. Possible values: * **en** (English, default), * **pl** (Polish). |

# PayU launches AI-ready developer tools for faster payment integrations

TOI Tech Desk / TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Updated: Jun 30, 2026, 10:01 IST

Comments

Share

AA

**Text Size**

* Small
* Medium
* Large

PayU, India’s leading diversified fintech platform, has announced two new developer tools designed to streamline modern payment workflows: PayU CLI and Builder MCP. The tools aim to simplify integration and operations for developers and merchants by bringing payment infrastructure directly into their everyday coding environments.The PayU CLI is designed for developers and operations teams managing daily payment workflows. Instead of navigating complex dashboards, teams can now:

* Create and send payment links
* Search and filter transactions
* Process refunds
* Review settlements
* Generate reports

The CLI supports multi-account management and seamless switching between test and production environments, making it particularly useful for DevOps teams handling multiple merchants.Together, Builder MCP and PayU CLI cover the full payment lifecycle. Developers can use Builder MCP during implementation to ship integrations faster, while operations teams can rely on PayU CLI for ongoing management of transactions, settlements, and refunds directly from the terminal.Narendra Babu, CTO of PayU, said: “AI has fundamentally transformed software development. Merchants and their tech teams are now looking for lightning-fast integrations and operational flexibility. Our new CLI and Builder MCP tools solve for each of these requirements by bringing PayU’s payment infrastructure to where developers work — in the terminal.”A developer using Cursor can request Builder MCP for PayU checkout integration code and receive ready-to-deploy JavaScript with error handling, reducing integration time from days to hours. Meanwhile, operations teams can use PayU CLI to instantly execute commands such as “create an INR 5,000 payment link” or “get yesterday’s settlement report” without dashboard navigation

# PayU Launches inFINity 3.0 to Fast-Track Early-Stage Fintech Startups from Build to Market-Ready Businesses

[](https://m.thewire.in/author/pti)

##### PTI

10 Feb 2026

Advertisement

Mumbai, Maharashtra, India (NewsVoir)

• InFINity 3.0 brings enhanced four-week acceleration with 1:1 mentorship, access to the PayU ecosystem, fintech VCs, and much more

• Applications are open until 6th March 2026 for fintech startups seeking seed to Series A funding

• Access to up to $10,000 AWS activate credits

PayU, India’s leading diversified fintech platform, today announced the launch of inFINity 3.0, the most ambitious and comprehensive edition of its fintech accelerator program to date. Designed for early-stage fintech startups, the latest edition of inFINity offers a high-octane opportunity for founders to validate product–market fit, sharpen Go-To-Market strategies, unlock distribution access, and build for institutional scale. As part of inFINity 3.0, PayU has partnered with Atrium Ventures, a micro venture capital firm, to provide select startups with direct exposure to early institutional capital. Atrium Ventures will mentor the cohort and actively participate in Demo Day, creating pathways for startups to pursue potential investment opportunities. Additionally, AWS continues as the Official Cloud Partner for inFINity 3.0, providing participating startups access to cloud infrastructure, technical enablement, and AWS Activate credits.

Advertisement

What does inFINity 3.0 offer:

• Fast-track to market through PayU’s ecosystem: Participants gain structured access to PayU’s bespoke payments solutions, merchant network, and banking partners. This enables faster pilots and real customer traction.

Advertisement

• Intensive four-week acceleration sprint: inFINity 3.0 runs a structured four-week sprint focused on Go-To-Market strategy, compliance navigation, scale, and making them investment ready—compressing months of learning into weeks

• 1:1 mentorship from fintech founders and ecosystem leaders: Founders receive direct guidance from PayU leaders, and domain experts who have built and scaled fintech businesses in India’s regulated markets.

Advertisement

• High-Impact Bootcamp and Demo Day hosted in India’s startup capital: The program culminates into an intensive 1.5-day Bootcamp and Demo Day in Bengaluru, featuring curated interactions with select fintech-founders, investors, and ecosystem partners.

Advertisement

As additional benefits, the selected cohort will also unlock up to $10,000 in AWS Cloud Credits per startup (subject to eligibility) \*(1), alongside exclusive masterclasses from industry stalwarts such as Umang Kumar, Co-founder & CEO, Cardekho SEA, and Nitin Jain, Co-founder, Ofbusiness.

"India's fintech ecosystem is at an inflection point, with budding founders solving real problems and driving economic impact at scale," said Anirban Mukherjee, CEO, PayU. "Through inFINity, our endeavor is to mentor these innovators and connect them with the right investors and strategic ecosystem partners they need to scale. It isn’t a strategy; it's our way of giving back to the ecosystem that's reshaping India's financial future. This is just a beginning, and we’ll continue building more ambitious initiatives to support our vision of nurturing the country’s fintech entrepreneurs.”

inFINity 3.0 builds on the extraordinary success of its first two editions that collectively received 1,000+ applications. Over the last two editions, the program has seen tangible outcomes such as distribution partnerships, commercial pilots, and increased investor readiness.

Program Timelines and Participation Criteria:

Applications for inFINity 3.0 are currently open and the last date to apply is 6th March 2026. Upon application closure, a four-week acceleration program will run throughout March 2026, culminating in an intensive 1.5-day Bootcamp and Demo Day in Bangalore during the third week of April 2026.

The application is open for early-stage fintech startups that have raised less than $5 million and are seeking seed to Series A funding.

Beyond inFINity, PayU has built one of India’s most comprehensive startup ecosystems, supporting founders across stages through PayU for Startups — enabling seamless payments, credit access, and scalable financial infrastructure. PayU has also partnered with government ecosystem enablers such as Startup India, DPIIT, state startup bodies including Karnataka and Uttar Pradesh, along with banking institutions such as IDFC FIRST Bank, to deliver tailored financial and payment solutions for startups, particularly beyond metro cities.

For more details, visit: www.infinitynow.tech

About PayU

PayU, India's leading diversified fintech platform with Prosus as an investor, operates businesses that are regulated by the Reserve Bank of India and offers advanced solutions to meet the digital financial services needs of customers (merchants, banks, and consumers).

PayU provides payment gateway solutions to online businesses through its cutting-edge and award-winning technology and has empowered 4.5 lakhs+ businesses, including India’s leading enterprises, e-commerce giants and SMBs. It enables businesses to collect digital payments across 100+ online payment methods such as Credit Cards, Debit Cards, Net Banking, EMIs, pay-later, QR, UPI, Wallets, and more. # PayU launches Agent HQ, an AI agent store for SMB merchants

TIMESOFINDIA.COM / Sep 11, 2026, 10:22 IST

Comments

Share

Aa

**Text Size**

* Small
* Medium
* Large

Print

PayU has announced Agent HQ, a dedicated AI agent store designed for Indian SMB merchants. The platform allows businesses to deploy specialised AI agents for every stage of commerce—from improving discoverability on AI shopping platforms to simplifying daily payment operations and powering custom conversational AI experiences.With nearly 50% of search traffic shifting to AI agents and AI‑referred shoppers converting up to three times better, PayU aims to give SMBs a level playing field. Agent HQ is built on more than a decade of commerce intelligence across 4.5 lakh+ merchants, 700+ million shopper journeys, and Rs 7,800 billion in processed transactions.Through Agent HQ, merchants can make their products and services discoverable and transactable on AI platforms like Claude, ChatGPT, and channels such as WhatsApp. They can also build custom conversational AI assistants for websites, apps and customer journeys, enabling real‑time shopper support and post‑purchase query handling.Agent HQ offers AI agents that automate operational tasks such as transaction follow‑ups, chargeback reconciliations, refund escalations and settlements. Using merchant transaction data—including success/failure patterns, chargeback histories and shopper behaviour—these agents can also suggest targeted campaigns across sales and marketing, helping reduce fraud, disputes and operational effort.Agent HQ is built directly into the PayU merchant dashboard. Merchants can hire an AI agent in a few clicks, set its frequency, monitor activity, and receive outputs via email and WhatsApp. All agents operate strictly within merchant‑defined boundaries.Manas Mishra, Chief Product Officer, PayU & Wibmo, said Agent HQ expands PayU’s value‑added offerings by giving merchants a personalised team of AI agents to improve discoverability, drive growth and manage payment operations.Merchants including Policybazaar, Daily Objects, and Pinq Polka are already using Agent HQ to enhance their commerce workflows.

# Top 5 PayU Alternatives In India 2026

## Contents

As businesses expand into new markets, their payment infrastructure needs begin to evolve alongside them. They have to focus on supporting customers’ preferences across regions, currencies, and payment ecosystems, meaning businesses should no longer look for a payment gateway but for infrastructure that supports global expansion.

While payment providers like PayU help address many of these challenges, businesses may sometimes need additional solutions to support better cross-border operations, multi-currency transactions, and localised customer experiences. Fortunately, India’s fintech market offers more payment gateway options than ever.

## The best PayU alternatives in India

### #1 Unlimit

Unlimit is a global financial infrastructure provider for ambitious businesses, combining global payment acceptance, local acquiring, multi-currency capabilities, and cross-border infrastructure into a single platform. It helps merchants scale beyond borders without having to rebuild their payment stack for every market.

Unlike many providers focused primarily on domestic acquiring, Unlimit is built around the idea that modern commerce is borderless. The platform gives merchants access to hyper-local and global payment methods across 200 markets in LATAM, APAC, Africa, Europe, and India.

### #2 CCAvenue

Founded in 2001, CCAvenue is one of India’s longest-standing payment gateways. Over the years, the platform has built a strong presence across the Indian e-commerce ecosystem by supporting a large variety of payment methods, integrations, and checkout experiences.

With tools for recurring, contactless, and in-stream payments, as well as custom forms, CCAvenue is widely used by businesses looking for broad payment acceptance and multi-currency capabilities.

### #3 Paytm

Paytm is one of India’s most recognised digital payment platforms. Originally built as a consumer wallet ecosystem, it has evolved into a full-stack payment gateway supporting subscriptions, invoicing, and international payment acceptance.

For businesses focused on growth, Paytm supports international card acceptance, real-time currency conversion at checkout, and integrations with websites, mobile apps, and enterprise commerce systems. The platform is particularly well known for its extensive coverage of payment methods with reliably high success rates.

### #4 PhonePe

With one of the country’s largest digital payment ecosystems, PhonePe gives businesses access to high-volume UPI acceptance, card payments, net banking, recurring payments, and omnichannel payment solutions through a unified gateway experience.

PhonePe has begun strengthening its international payment capabilities, enabling businesses to accept payments from global customers while settling funds locally in INR. Its infrastructure focuses on simplifying onboarding, improving payment success rates, and creating faster checkout experiences across mobile and web channels.  This makes it particularly attractive to businesses with a strong India-focused customer base looking to scale digitally.

### #5 Bill Desk

BillDesk is one of India’s oldest and most established digital payment infrastructure providers, widely known for powering large-scale bill payments and enterprise payment flows nationwide.

Its infrastructure is built around transaction stability, regulatory alignment, and large-scale reconciliation capabilities, enabling BillDesk to establish a strong reputation among banks, government entities, insurance providers, and large enterprises that require a stable, high-volume payment processing infrastructure.

## Choose the right payment infrastructure for global growth

As global commerce continues to evolve, businesses need an infrastructure that supports expansion across markets, currencies, and payment ecosystems without adding operational complexity.

Unlimit combines hyper-local payment coverage, direct acquiring infrastructure, cross-border capabilities, and multi-currency financial tools into a single programmable stack, helping businesses turn global expansion into a matter of code.

## FAQs

The right PayU alternative in India should support local and international payment methods, offer transparent pricing, simplify onboarding, provide reliable settlement infrastructure, and scale easily as the business enters new markets. Cross-border capabilities, such as multi-currency support, local acquiring, and access to hyper-local payment methods, are also important for better conversion rates and customer experience.

The best payment gateways for a business depend on its model and expansion goals. Some providers focus primarily on domestic payments, while others are designed around international commerce and cross-border settlements. Businesses selling globally should prioritise payment gateways that offer multi-currency support, international card acceptance, local payment methods across different countries, fast settlement times, regulatory and compliance support, and transparent FX and cross-border pricing.

Businesses in India can partner with a modern payment infrastructure provider to accept international payments without having to set up legal entities in every market. This significantly reduces operational complexity and accelerates international expansion.

The Reserve Bank of India’s Payment Aggregator-Cross Border (PA-CB) framework regulates payment gateways handling cross-border payments for Indian businesses. Merchants should work with a provider that holds RBI authorisation, as this offers greater regulatory clarity and stronger compliance support when processing international payments.

# PhonePe Launches AI-Powered search built using Microsoft Foundry

*Users can now navigate, pay and track transaction insights by using simple voice or text commands*

**National, 20 February 2026:** PhonePe today announced the launch of an AI-powered natural language search feature built using Microsoft Foundry. This feature enables PhonePe users to initiate and complete in-app tasks via natural language text or voice commands, enhancing convenience and bringing personalization to the platform’s overall experience.

The feature uses capabilities enabled by Microsoft Foundry to replace traditional navigation with intent-based routing, directly guiding users to their intended destination. For instance, a request such as “Pay Hemanth 20 rupees” automatically launches the payment interface with the recipient pre-selected or displays all relevant contacts named Hemanth. Similarly, commands like “Recharge FASTag” or “Gold price” navigate the user to the appropriate page or surface with the most relevant information or transactional options.

Beyond simple transactions, this feature captures insights and can interpret whether a user is trying to make a payment, complete a purchase, or reach support for help. All of this is achieved via a hybrid model that combines local on-device and cloud inferencing, while keeping all processing secure and ensuring privacy with no personal or transactional data leaving the PhonePe environment.

Speaking on the launch, **Rahul Chari, Founder, Whole-time Director & CTO, PhonePe**, said: “*For years, payment apps have been built as utilitarian tools, optimized for transactions and not people. This launch is the first step towards changing that. Our vision is to make payments accessible to every Indian, and AI enables us to build an intelligent interface that anticipates what users need before they even go looking for it. Through our collaboration with Microsoft, we aim to simplify payments further by understanding intent, not just inputs. And we believe intelligence at the edge is the future and the most thoughtful way to deliver real value without compromising on privacy or security.*”

**Puneet Chandok, President, Microsoft India and South Asia** said: “*As more Indians embrace natural language to interact with digital services, PhonePe’s new AI-powered experience is a strong step toward more intuitive and accessible digital payments. Microsoft Foundry provides the underlying capabilities that help innovators like PhonePe build secure, scalable and human-centred products for millions. We’re committed to supporting India’s digital ecosystem with trusted AI that empowers organisations to deliver simpler and more meaningful customer experiences*.”

The feature will be rolled out in phases to users across India. Users can access the feature via the Global Search Bar, Help Center and the History tab on the PhonePe payments app.

About PhonePe: 
PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of September 30, 2025, PhonePe has over 65 Crore registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4.7 Crore merchants.

PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace).

# PhonePe and Visa Partner to Power Comprehensive Cardless Payments for Millions of Indians Globally

*~Unveiled at GFF 2026, PhonePe becomes India’s first App to offer a unified suite of Visa features including Tap to Pay, Cross Border Scan to Pay, online Device Tokenization, and Smart Accept~*

**National, September 9th, 2026:** PhonePe and Visa today jointly announced the launch of three new payment solutions: Tap to Pay, Cross Border Scan to Pay, and Smart Accept. Unveiled on stage by leadership from both organizations at the Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2026, the partnership makes PhonePe the first app in India to introduce Cross Border Scan to Pay for international transactions.

Furthermore, PhonePe becomes the first app to enable a complete suite of three core Visa capabilities for consumers: Online Device Tokenization, Tap to Pay, and Cross Border Scan to Pay. Additionally, the platform is empowering micro-merchants with card acceptance through Smart Accept.

Building upon the Visa Device Tokenization launched on the platform in February 2025, this initiative establishes a seamless, cardless payment ecosystem. Once users save their Visa card on PhonePe, they can simply tap their phone to pay at stores, check out online at their favorite merchants, or scan QR codes while traveling abroad, eliminating the need to carry physical cards altogether.

Key Features of these payment solutions include:

* **Tap to Pay**: Android users can tokenize their Visa cards to make contactless payments at Point-of-Sale (POS) machines, even in low-connectivity environments. Tap to Pay will roll out progressively in phases, starting September 9, 2026.
* **Cross Border Scan to Pay:** Unveiled at the launch event, this feature allows users to scan Visa-supported QR codes across 14 key international markets including Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia, Sri Lanka, Japan, China, and South Korea, removing currency exchange friction for Indian travelers abroad. This feature will be rolled out to users soon.
* **Unified Online Tokenization:** Integrated into the platform, users enjoy a secure ‘save once, use everywhere’ checkout experience across all participating e-commerce merchants. Millions of consumers are already experiencing this feature on the PhonePe platform.
* **Smart Accept:** Also unveiled at the launch event, this feature empowers small merchants to accept card payments directly on their smartphones without buying a separate card POS machine. Customers can pay by tapping physical cards or tokenized mobile wallets directly against the merchant's device, eliminating the need for separate POS hardware. The solution brings the cost of card-present device ownership to zero, offers seamless onboarding and optimized commercial rates, and fully integrates card payments into PhonePe's existing QR dashboard for unified daily reconciliation and simplified dispute resolution.

Speaking on the launch, **Rahul Chari, Founder & CPTO at PhonePe** said, "*At PhonePe, our vision has always been to build technology that makes payments universally accessible, intuitive, and secure. Partnering with Visa is a pivotal milestone in scaling that vision globally. By unifying online tokenization, Tap to Pay, and Cross-Border QR payments alongside Smart Accept for merchants, we are removing friction across the entire payments value chain. Through this partnership, we are not just digitizing cards, we are establishing a new standard for borderless and cardless commerce for Indian consumers and micro-merchants alike.*”

**Suresh Sethi, Group Country Manager, India and South Asia, Visa**, said, "*India is at the forefront of the global digital payments revolution, and Visa is proud to be a catalyst in this transformation. Our partnership with PhonePe is another step forward in this direction and reflects a shared vision - to make trusted, secure and frictionless commerce accessible to every Indian, across borders. By bringing together our global network, tokenization capabilities, and PhonePe's unparalleled reach, into a seamless experience, we are not just simplifying payments, we are reimagining how India connects with the global economy. This collaboration reaffirms Visa's vision of being the best way to pay and be paid worldwide, delivering payment experiences that are as secure as they are effortless.*"

Harvard takes a deep dive into PhonePe's journey In October 2021, PhonePe’s journey towards democratizing payments in India featured as a Harvard Business Review case study. Amidst a surge in demand for digital financial services, PhonePe emerged as a leader through product innovation and rapid merchant acquisition. Our Co-Founder & CTO, Rahul Chari, recently spent time with the MBA class on the entrepreneurship case study at Harvard Business School to share a cockpit view of PhonePe’s hyper growth journey over the past 7 years. He explained how our user base has exploded to a staggering 520 million registered users, empowering millions of Indians to actively participate in the digital economy and how PhonePe continues to drive financial inclusion and unlock opportunities for millions of Indians; with a vast network of over 38 million merchants spanning over 99% of India's postal codes; effectively competing with global giants. The HBR case study raised pivotal questions about the industry's evolving landscape and the role of fintech companies in digital transformation. “Interestingly, when the case study was being written we faced crucial decisions regarding PhonePe's strategic direction. While evaluating expansion and diversification options between international markets or increase in growth in India; should we capitalize on our UPI dominance or prioritize serving as a trusted intermediary for services like insurance and mutual funds? Each path presented unique complexities and challenges, driving us to continually brainstorm and innovate for the optimal solution” explains Rahul. The leadership's strategic direction to create a digital payments app and expand it into a comprehensive financial services platform proved to be fruitful. Strong fundamentals such as technology development that sustains scalability, regulatory compliance, and a long-term talent strategy fueled exponential growth. While the 2021 case study captured early achievements, PhonePe's story continues to grow at an incredible pace. The HBR case study is now in its third iteration, a testament to it’s relentless innovation and growth. In his interaction, Rahul explained how PhonePe's vision expanded beyond being a financial services platform that empowered its users with options like insurance, digital gold, mutual funds, stock broking, and lending. PhonePe embarked on further diversification; venturing into tech-enabled businesses like the hyperlocal shopping app - Pincode and the launch of India's first localized app store: Indus Appstore. He concluded by describing PhonePe as an ongoing case study always evaluating the best way forward, and the next chapter promises more groundbreaking innovation and impact. # PhonePe Success Story: How It Became India's Top Digital Payment App

The PhonePe success story is among the most notable success stories in India, illustrating how the innovative concept turned out to be a fintech giant that provides its services to millions of customers. Through innovation, putting the customer first, and using UPI, PhonePe revolutionized the digital payments space for Indians. Now, PhonePe has expanded beyond payments to become a complete financial ecosystem including insurance, investments, and more while playing an important role in developing the digital economy of India.

## What is PhonePe?

The PhonePe success story started with a goal of creating a convenient, secure, and affordable way for every Indian to perform digital payments. Prior to the emergence of UPI, digital payments used to involve transferring funds to the wallet or completing some steps to verify the user before making any transactions, which made it complicated for many people. The founders of PhonePe had an idea of providing a way for bank-to-bank transfers without compromising ease of use for customers.

PhonePe was launched in December 2015 in Bengaluru, India, and very soon became one of the most early fintech startups which developed its platform on the basis of the Unified Payments Interface (UPI). In contrast to a regular digital wallet, PhonePe provided customers with an option to link their bank accounts and send money immediately.

Since then, PhonePe has grown much beyond the scope of its primary activity. Currently, the company is developing as a complete solution for customers who need to transfer money, top up their mobile balance, pay for utility bills, take insurance policies, invest into mutual funds, purchase digital gold, book travel tickets, as well as other financial products. The ability to expand and develop continuously without losing convenience has become a decisive factor in the success story of PhonePe.

## Key Features and Services

One of the main factors that have made PhonePe successful is its variety of services which cover all possible everyday needs of the customer. Unlike others, PhonePe has developed its integrated ecosystem step by step.

Some of its most popular services include:

* Instant UPI money transfers
* QR code payments
* Mobile and DTH recharge
* Electricity, gas, water, and broadband bill payments
* Credit card bill payments
* Fastag recharge
* Insurance services
* Mutual fund investments
* Digital gold purchases
* Loan and lending solutions
* Travel bookings
* Gift cards
* Merchant payment solutions
* Business payment services

The app's simple navigation and secure payment infrastructure make these services accessible to users of all age groups. Whether someone wants to pay a small grocery bill or invest in financial products, PhonePe provides everything within one platform.

## Company Profile

The history of the PhonePe startup illustrates the journey of the Indian digital payment sector. What once began as a fintech startup in Bengaluru has turned into one of the biggest financial technology companies in the country.

PhonePe was founded based on the vision of establishing a cashless payment system with the help of the UPI technology. Rather than promoting the holding of money in wallets, it linked itself directly with the bank accounts, thus providing fast and clear transactions.

With the growth in the number of customers, PhonePe expanded its services in many different financial sectors. Currently, it deals with many different areas, including:

* Digital payments
* Merchant services
* Financial products
* Wealth management
* Insurance
* Lending
* Investments

And its digital system processes millions of transactions daily, providing services for individual customers, retailers, startups, and even large businesses.

Yet another feature that makes PhonePe unique is its efforts to promote financial inclusion. It has made aggressive moves to reach small towns and rural areas, enabling merchants in these areas to use digital payments by providing them with QR codes and low-cost merchant solutions.

## The Founders Behind the PhonePe Success Story

Each and every successful enterprise is created by visionaries in entrepreneurship. With their skills in technology, innovation in products and strategy in business, the founders of PhonePe established one of the most popular digital wallets in India.

### Sameer Nigam

Sameer Nigam is one of the founders and CEOs of PhonePe. Before PhonePe, Sameer Nigam gathered a lot of experience in product development and technology leadership. Thus, Sameer had a good idea of how people act in front of digital products.

According to Sameer, payments through digital wallets should be similar to the procedure of sending a text message. It means that in every step in creation of the app, Nigam thought about how to simplify the customers' lives and solve their problems.

### Rahul Chari

Rahul Chari is an experienced technical person who contributed to PhonePe creation with his experience and competence. With increasing user base for PhonePe, it was necessary to ensure stability in the system. This was made possible through Rahul’s expertise in engineering.

### Burzin Engineer

Burzin Engineer was a part of the founding team that took care of product engineering and technology architecture.

He was focused on creating a platform that allowed continuous innovation without compromising on speed and performance. The introduction of new products such as insurance, loans, merchant services, and investments at PhonePe further made stability in the platform critical. Burzin’s engineering leadership helped PhonePe grow its offerings without compromising on the customer experience.

**2018**

* Achieves the milestone of crossing 1 billion transactions
* Launches micro-apps on the platform

**2019**

* Awarded with “Best Mobile Payment Product or Service” at 9th IAMAI Indian Digital Awards

* Achieves another milestone with 2 billion transactions on the app

**2020**

* Launches PhonePe ATM across 10 lakh stores in more than 300 cities
* Adds the feature to buy insurance including motor, travel and coronavirus insurance
* Achieved the milestone of 250 million registered users
* Enjoyed a share of over 40% in UPI Transactions

### PhonePe Revenue Model

Over the course of years, PhonePe has added many sources of revenue to its business and now it isn’t just a digital wallet/UPI-based payment platform. PhonePe generates revenue from commission from a variety of sources:

* Mobile recharges and postpaid bill payments
* Utility bill payments (gas, electricity and water)
* DTH recharge
* Bu
* Selling Insurance
* Selling Gold
* By charging merchants a commission on every sale through PhonePe UPI/Wallet
* As a data miner for Yes Bank
* Mutual funds
* Bus, train and flight reservations

### PhonePe Funding

The online payment app has raised nearly $1.5 billion through multiple rounds of funding. Homegrown E-commerce giant Flipkart has been the major investor in PhonePe. Notably, Walmart too invested in the platform in the December 2020 round of funding.

The most recent funds came to the Singapore unit of PhonePe in the form of $66.5 million (roughly INR 500 crore) in a funding round led by Chinese technology firm Tencent Holdings along with participation of New York-based investor Tiger Global.

Flipkart continues to be the largest stakeholder in PhonePe with 87.30% stake, followed by Walmart, as reported by EconomicTimes.

#### The Evolution of PhonePe

What started as a digital wallet and UPI-based payments app is now a multi-purpose platform which can do many amazing things in the financial world. PhonePe has entered into many partnerships to reach the position where it is today. Some notable partnerships include:

In 2018, the company partnered with giants like Jio Money and Airtel Money. As a result, users could link their PhonePe accounts with these platforms.

PhonePe is a proud partner of more than 180 consumer brands, including RedBus, Ola, Swiggy, Myntra, Goibibo and OYO.

Then, PhonePe entered into the market of mutual funds by collaborating with Aditya Birla Sun Life Mutual Funds. The partnership implied that PhonePe users could invest in mutual funds and make decent savings for the future.

PhonePe launched its international travel insurance in collaboration with Bajaj Allianz General Insurance. This happened in January 2020, and with this PhonePe became the first digital payment platform in the nation to do so.

PhonePe ATM

PhonePe added another feather to its cap in early 2020 with the launch of PhonePe Atm. Don’t be confused – it isn’t the ordinary bank atm that you visit to withdraw cash. Rather, through this service you can get instant cash from nearby merchants/shops offering this facility. The service is presently only available in the Delhi-NCR region, and will be extended to other states in a progressive manner.

**Here’s how you can avail cash through PhonePe ATM:**

* Click on the ‘Stores’ Tab at the bottom of your PhonePe app’s screen
* Select ‘PhonePe ATM’ to see a list of nearby shops offering the PhonePe ATM service.
* As of now, you can avail a cash of INR 1000 a day from the merchant.
* Visit the shop, click on the ‘withdraw’ option and transfer the required amount to the merchant.
* That’s it! The merchant will provide you the cash equal to the amount transferred.

# PhonePe Payment Gateway Integration | Roadmap, Cost Factors, Skills

22 September 2025 Website Development By Autuskey Team

18 MINS READ    5386 VIEWS    Updated Sep 25, 2025

## LISTEN TO THIS ARTICLE

﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿Every time someone clicks “Buy Now” or “Pay with UPI,” that magic behind the screen is powered by smart Payment Gateway integration. If your website can’t accept payments smoothly, you risk losing a customer in seconds. 

And when you get it right, securely, fast, and reliably, you build trust, reduce drop-offs, and grow revenue.

Did you know: According to The Economic Times, in August 2025, India’s UPI system processed over 20 billion transactions in one month, worth about ₹24.85 lakh crore. That is a jump of 34% in volume compared to August 2024.

That’s the proof that people in India are not just okay with digital payments. They are embracing them with full force.

If you’re building a site or running an online business in India, integrating something like the PhonePe payment gateway could make or break the user experience.

This guide will walk you through everything: what a gateway is, how the PhonePe API works (SDK or custom), what it costs, what skills you need, and how to avoid common pitfalls.

By the end, you’ll clearly see why strong payment gateway api integration isn’t just a technical add-on, it’s a growth engine. Let's get started.

## Payment Gateway Integration

Payment Gateway integration is the backbone of digital commerce. It allows businesses to process payments safely while improving customer trust and purchase experience.

Moreover, since online shopping is growing rapidly, seamless integration has become a necessity.

Now, let’s move deeper into the basics before exploring why it matters for modern websites.

### What is a payment gateway?

A payment gateway is a secure bridge between a customer and a business. It captures, encrypts, and transfers payment details to complete transactions smoothly.

In simple words, it is the digital cashier handling money online. Subsequently, because customers value security, payment gateway integration makes sure that their information remains safe during every purchase.

This role makes the gateway critical for eCommerce stores, SaaS platforms, and subscription-based businesses. In fact, it is especially important when comparing the best payment gateways in India for reliable transactions.

Moreover, according to Mordor Intelligence, the India Payment Gateway Market is projected to grow from USD 2.07 billion in 2025 to USD 3.62 billion by 2030, at a CAGR of 11.89%. This highlights how businesses increasingly rely on these systems for digital payments.

### Why integration matters in modern websites?

For today’s digital businesses, Payment Gateway integration is more than convenience. It directly impacts sales, brand reputation, and customer retention.

Therefore, companies must understand their role before implementing api integration payment gateway solutions.

* To begin with, payment gateway integration builds trust by protecting sensitive card and UPI details.
* Subsequently, it reduces cart abandonment with faster checkouts. This is crucial because the average global cart abandonment rate is about 70%, as per Statista. This shows how many shoppers leave without completing purchases.
* Expands reach by supporting multiple payment modes.
* Lastly, it simplifies business operations with automated transaction records.

Ultimately, integration is not optional anymore. Instead, it is the foundation for delivering smooth, reliable, and competitive online experiences.

## Skills Required for Payment Gateway API Integration

Successful Payment Gateway integration demands a blend of expertise across multiple domains. That being said, developers need to think beyond design and focus on security, efficiency, and reliability.

Since every layer plays a role, skills must complement each other for smooth performance.

### 1) Front-End Development Knowledge

Customers first interact with the front end. Clean layouts, quick form validations, and mobile responsiveness directly affect trust.

For this reason, front-end specialists craft seamless experiences. Without their contribution, Payment Gateway integration would feel clumsy and would lead to abandoned checkouts.

### 2) Back-End Development Knowledge

While users never see it, the back end powers every secure transaction. Developers configure databases, manage sessions, and validate requests.

Consequently, businesses cannot overlook this stage. API integration payment gateway heavily depends on code stability and server communication accuracy.

### 3) API Integration Skills

APIs bridge merchants with gateways. Further, developers work with keys, endpoints, and structured responses for reliable transactions. Additionally, they must handle timeouts, retries, and error codes.

Without skilled payment gateway API integration, failures rise, and customer confidence drops instantly.

### 4) Security Protocol Expertise

Security expertise protects financial data. Therefore, teams implement SSL, tokenization, and two-factor authentication where necessary.

As a result, hackers are not able to exploit vulnerabilities. For any Payment Gateway integration, prioritizing this skill is vital because one breach can destroy credibility permanently.

### 5) Testing and Debugging Abilities

Sandbox trials mimic real transactions. Through this, testers explore weak spots, analyze logs, and run stress simulations. Thus, potential issues surface early.

By refining the API integration payment gateway before launch, businesses can reduce risks and improve customer satisfaction immediately.

With balanced expertise, Payment Gateway integration becomes smooth, efficient, and dependable. In short, investing in capable talent transforms integration into a business advantage rather than a technical struggle.

# India’s PhonePe ends partnership with payment orchestrator Juspay

PhonePe has secured a payment aggregator license in March 2023. Credit: Aniket Gaikwad/ Shutterstock. · Electronic Payments · Aniket Gaikwad/ Shutterstock.

GlobalData

2 min read

Indian digital payments firm backed by Walmart, PhonePe has terminated its partnership with SoftBank-backed payment orchestration platform Juspay in a move to directly integrate payment solutions for its merchants.

PhonePe has over 40 million merchants in its network, reported Business Standard.

In a statement, PhonePe spokesperson said: "As a payment aggregator, one of our core roles is to provide best-in-class success rates to our merchants through our solutions. We are able to do this consistently for merchants directly integrated with us and hence have decided not to offer our solutions through any payment orchestration platform."

The spokesperson added: "Going forward, the company will offer its solutions to merchants through direct integrations only."

A few major companies have obtained approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to function as payment aggregators.

PhonePe has secured a payment aggregator license in March 2023.

According to CNBC TV18 report, Entrackr was the first to disclose this information, adding that approximately 15% of PhonePe's payment gateway transactions are presently being handled by Juspay.

Meanwhile, in a separate development, PhonePe announced the launch of a new dengue and malaria insurance plan on its platform. With premiums starting at a nominal Rs59 per year, the plan aims to provide affordable health coverage of up to Rs100,000 for medical expenses arising from vector and air-borne diseases.

It is aimed at financially safeguarding users, especially in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities, against unforeseen medical costs throughout the year.

The insurance plan offers coverage against more than ten vector-borne and air-borne diseases, ensuring continuous protection for its users all year round.

Moreover, the insurance cover is designed to complement existing health insurance policies, including those provided by employers.

"India's PhonePe ends partnership with payment orchestrator Juspay " was originally created and published by Electronic Payments International, a GlobalData owned brand.

# PhonePe Rolls Out UPI Payments with Biometric Authentication

*Consumers can now pay with user friendly alternatives to UPI PIN such as fingerprint or face authentication for transactions up to ₹5,000*

**National, 19 February 2026:** PhonePe today announced the launch of biometric authentication for UPI payments, enabling a faster and more seamless ‘one-touch’ payment experience for its users. This new feature allows users to authorize transactions using their smartphone’s native security, such as fingerprint or facial recognition, eliminating the need to manually enter a UPI PIN for transactions. With this launch, PhonePe becomes one of the first major payments players to bring this capability to market at scale.

This feature is designed to elevate both the security and reliability of digital payments by addressing common friction points in the user’s payment journey. By leveraging device-level biometric verification, this feature ensures that users can transact securely even in crowded public spaces, effectively eliminating the risk of ‘shoulder-surfing’ or PIN exposure. Beyond security, the integration significantly improves transaction success rates by reducing failures often caused by forgotten or incorrectly entered UPI PINs. To ensure a consistent experience, the feature includes a seamless fallback mechanism that allows users to instantly switch back to using their standard UPI PIN if biometric authentication is hindered by factors like poor lighting or sensor issues.

In line with current regulatory guidelines, this ‘one-touch’ approach leverages device-level biometric verification as a secure two-factor authentication layer for UPI transactions up to ₹5,000. Transactions exceeding this limit will continue to require UPI PIN authentication to ensure maximum security. Consumers will be able to utilize biometric authentication across every day use cases such as peer to peer money transfers, scanning a QR to make payments in-store or online payments and even to check their bank balance.

Speaking on the launch, **Deep Agrawal, Head of Payments at PhonePe**, said, “*At PhonePe, our goal has always been to make digital payments as intuitive and accessible as possible for every Indian. By integrating biometric authentication, we are taking a significant step toward a truly frictionless payment experience. This feature not only saves time but adds a hardware-grade layer of security that protects users in their everyday environments. We believe that by eliminating common friction points, we are making digital payments more seamless and secure for everyone*.”

**How to Enable Biometric Payments:** Users can set up the feature in a few simple steps:

* Open the PhonePe app.
* Go to **Profile**.
* Tap on **Manage Payments**.
* Tap on the **Biometric Pay Icon**.
* Enable Biometric Authentication for UPI Payments for respective Bank accounts.
* Confirm using your UPI PIN and Biometric for a one-time setup.

The feature is currently available for Android users, supporting both fingerprint and facial recognition capabilities, with iOS functionality expected to launch shortly.

**About PhonePe:**

PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services, Financial Services and Marketplace Solutions. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of September 30, 2025, PhonePe has over 65 Crore registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 4.7 Crore merchants.

PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace).

sources.title: Indian parliamentary panel red-flags PhonePe and Google Pay cornering 83% of India's UPI payments amid Paytm clampdown | TechCrunch
sources.content:
An Indian parliamentary panel has urged the government to support the growth of domestic fintech players that can provide alternatives to the Walmart-backed PhonePe and Google Pay apps that currently command more than 83% of the country’s fast-growing digital payments market.

The 58-page report, which includes a series of recommendations, comes at a time when Paytm, another leading payments firm in the country, is reeling from a clampdown on its payments bank business.

The Reserve Bank of India’s directive last week all but asks Paytm to cease operations of Paytm Payments Bank, which processes most of the transactions for the financial services firm. The disruption at Paytm will likely cause the payment app’s market share in UPI to fall further to rivals PhonePe and Google Pay, industry executives cautioned.

PhonePe commanded 46.91% of the UPI market share by volume during the period of October to November 2023, the parliamentary committee on communications and IT wrote in its report. Google Pay held a market share of 36.39% during the same period, the report said.

The market share by volume of indigenous BHIM UPI was only 0.22%, the report said. PhonePe and Google Pay likely possess a large market share of UPI by transaction value.

The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI), a special unit of the Indian central bank RBI, has previously expressed similar concerns about the clear duopoly in the mobile payments market in South Asia. It had earlier proposed enforcing a check on the market share for players, ensuring that no single player shall process more than 30% of the UPI transactions in a month.

The NPCI, which oversees UPI payments network, in late 2022 extended the deadline for the new check to the end of 2024. Google Pay and PhonePe assumed less than 80% market share at the time when the NPCI originally proposed a check in 2020.

“As India, focusing on ‘Make in India’ in other sectors, the Committee are of the opinion that local entities are to be promoted in the fintech sector,” the report added.

## Key Differences Between Cashfree and Razorpay for Payment Gateway Services

* **Primary Focus and Use Cases:** Cashfree positions itself as a versatile payments platform with strong support for payouts, auto-collect, marketplace payments, and reconciliation workflows. Razorpay offers a comprehensive payments ecosystem with gateway services, full payment processing, subscription support, and additional business-financial tools under one umbrella.
* **User Experience and Onboarding:** Cashfree provides a simple API-driven setup that makes it relatively easy for businesses to integrate payments and payouts quickly. Razorpay provides a streamlined onboarding flow with ready-made integrations, checkout UI options, and a unified dashboard — making it accessible for small to large businesses alike.
* **Payment Methods and Coverage:** Cashfree supports a wide range of payment methods including cards, UPI, net banking, wallets, and more — offering broad flexibility for Indian customers. Razorpay supports cards, UPI, wallets, net banking, EMI options, and also offers extensive support for recurring payments and subscription billing workflows.
* **Payouts, Auto-Collect & Business-Friendly Features:** Cashfree stands out for payout-oriented features, auto-collect via virtual accounts, marketplace payouts, and tools suited for businesses requiring frequent disbursals or vendor payments. Razorpay supports payment collection, subscription billing, and also offers fintech-adjacent services like business banking, making it suitable for companies needing an end-to-end payment + financial-services ecosystem.
* **Integration Flexibility and Ecosystem Compatibility:** Cashfree provides flexible APIs and supports integrations that help merchants set up custom flows, automate reconciliation, and work with marketplaces. Razorpay offers plugins for major e-commerce platforms, SDKs for web/mobile, and a wider ecosystem — helpful for businesses looking for quick, plug-and-play integrations alongside financial services.
* **Ideal Audience and Application:** Cashfree is ideal for businesses, marketplaces, or platforms that need a strong payout infrastructure, vendor/vendor-pay disbursement, and flexible payment collection across multiple methods. This post is for startup decision-makers, Solopreneurs, and freelancers who need to make a quick, yet informed decision on a payment gateway. While none of these options may be perfect, the goal is to find something reliable and “good enough” to get you launched. This is all based on my personal experience with these payment gateways, so I’m sharing what worked well for me and what didn’t.

## **Comparison Basis**

We will compare the solutions based on

Things that I don’t dive into

**Payment methods** 
I won’t be diving into the specifics of what each gateway offers in terms of payment methods because all three — Razorpay, PayU, and CCAvenue — provide a comprehensive range of options that are more than sufficient for getting started. Whether it’s credit/debit cards, UPI, net banking, or wallets, these gateways cover all the essential services. I believe there’s hardly any payment method or service you’d need that they don’t already support. So, I don’t think you should be concerned about losing a customer for good if the chosen gateway fails to provide the method the customer wants — it’s unlikely to happen with any of these options.

**Security** 
All three gateways — Razorpay, PayU, and CCAvenue — are PCI DSS certified. PCI DSS stands for Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard, a set of rules that ensure companies handling credit card information do so securely. This means these gateways follow strict security measures to protect your payment information. They use encryption, secure data storage, and regular checks to keep everything safe. For both businesses and customers, this certification ensures that payment data is protected from potential threats like data breaches and fraud.
